title: Every operator alert reaches the manager: one durable alert ledger on the VM, served by the API, pushed to the manager by a wake, not only Telegram
note: [SYSTEM-AUDIT-INTEGRATION F1-F4, docs/audits/2026-11-04-system-integration.md] MEASURED 2026-11-04: runtime_logs/operator_alerts.jsonl held 30 alerts 00:00-18:07Z (14 all_accounts_failed, 10 stuck_strategy, 4 orphan_reconciliation, 2 close_failure); 0 of them appear in GET /api/bot/work/report?since= digestLog (19 hourly entries) or /work/brief. 14 alert kinds write that ring; the other Telegram senders (82 files in telegram_channels.SENDERS; 37 with no durable-sink marker by a grep probe) reach Telegram+FCM only. The only manager push channel is ops-flags PR #17895 (research watchdog, SLO, LTR wake, desk wake). Operator free text in Telegram never reaches Claude (src/bot/claude_bridge.py:262). CANDIDATE BUILD (design pending DEEP-AUDIT-20261104; draft only): (1) one chokepoint ledger write in telegram_channels.send for every non-reply kind, (2) GET /api/bot/alerts?since= with read_state, (3) a VM-side wake that comments ONE compact line per new alert-class event (dedup by kind+key, rate-capped) on #17895, (4) the manager's start-of-session + review step reads /alerts?since=<last review>. Gates this adds: none (no send is blocked; the ledger write is best-effort). DETECTOR: an all_accounts_failed alert fired on the VM appears in /api/bot/alerts and as a #17895 comment within 10 min, without anyone pasting it. [2026-11-04T20:06Z lane session_01AFoLuLCbQTSU5jK9dbmcvU] DESIGN LANDED in docs/audits/2026-11-04-system-integration.md § 'Design: how alerts, data and state reach the manager' (after DEEP-AUDIT-20261104, #22902). It supersedes the CANDIDATE BUILD above. Binding: audit #11 (detectors are reports) and #13 (one register: the ledger is an EVENT log, and follow-ups become dated rows in the one register). Build order: (1) ledger append in notify.send_telegram_direct, plus a POST /api/bot/alerts for shell and workflow senders; (2) GET /api/bot/alerts and /api/diag/alerts with read_state; (3) an alert_watch pass in attention_watch.py, with ict-work-digest.timer moving hourly -> *:0/5 (the digest stays hourly through _cadence_gate); one comment of <=1,500 chars per burst on #17895; LTR wake comments trimmed; (4) manager skill: subscribe #17895 and read /alerts at start and at the 05:52/17:52 reviews, plus a work report alerts section; (5) inbound operator_message. DETECTOR: a synthetic send_route_test_ping reaches /api/bot/alerts and #17895 within 10 min; re-run F1 goes from 0/30 to 30/30. 2026-11-05 00:53Z: #23033 merged (63d670a03c) under operator 'Pre-approve (Recommended)'. Deploy via git-sync; manager check-in 01:11Z. Closing observation: an alert row in /api/diag/alerts with delivered set + ONE <=1,500-char comment on #17895 within 10 min of a system/high alert (test ping route_test_ping if no natural one by ~01:40Z); ict-work-digest.timer firing every 5 min. Lane session_01AFoLuHvCcdYpY4aF1dh5M9 finished. OBSERVED 2026-11-05 00:55Z: deployed (alert_watch ran on the VM). A natural system alert (kind restart, system/normal, delivered telegram_ok) produced ONE alert-watch comment on #17895 (comment 6646563434, ~330 chars, well under 1,500) within seconds; LTR compaction pass is editing old wake comments (bounded: first 100 comments updated in 3d, 5 edits per pass). Not yet checked: /api/diag/alerts read directly, and the timer cadence (*:0/5) over more than one pass.
